limits: This is a final local-source/provenance review. The currently running native workflow is still the published b5 candidate and cannot validate these prepared v8 QA changes.

All eight changed/new non-documentation candidate paths are QA workflow, runner, provenance or quality-test files. Generated Python bytecode under scripts/quality/__pycache__ is explicitly excluded from the candidate and preparation enumeration.

No App.tsx, index.js, app.config.js, src, shared, modules or tests/native runtime bytes or tracked modes differ from literal b5; there are no new runtime files. This does not prove unchanged runtime behavior under a different emulator renderer.

The six existing disposable overlays are unchanged, including the QA-only renderer-capability overlay. Production memory capability remains 0 and no runtime capability or music licensing change is introduced.
The journal helper and renderer have their separately source-bound focused review receipts. Those repeated local test counts are not added here, and no further test group ran for this review.
No claim is made that Mesa prevents the host SIGSEGV, that a journal record will exist, or that full native navigation/capture/decode acceptance has passed.
